method.condition_masking: Criterion records use neutral labels derived from the exact composite candidate hashes. Configuration names are applied only in the condition mapping and comparative disposition.
method.independence: The review occurred after both sealed trajectories and was never actor-visible.
method.masking_limit: The program investigator supervised execution and therefore this is condition-masked candidate review, not an independent third-party evaluator-blind replication.
method.evidence_rule: Only the frozen task, Cedar sources, exact candidate bytes, candidate-bound mechanical evaluations, and sealed effect-delivery records were used. Plausible but unsupported emergency-management claims are defects.
method.quality_rule: Mechanical term coverage, behavioral progress, lower cost, or broader citation alone cannot establish completeness or readiness.

criterion_dispositions.finding: Distinguishes fire-behavior recommendation, incident-command legal order and closure, supporting-branch execution, candidate checking, acknowledged handoff, and advisory-only dashboards or model output.

Uses the conservative envelope and sub-six-hour Zone A concept, but materially converts 5.8 hours and a 42 percent wind-shift probability into a 5.8 km/h wind threshold and 42 percent relative humidity; it also lacks a coherent single forecast-cycle binding and explicit hold/expand observations.

Preserves population totals and overlap, but does not derive a time-bound clearance demand and incorrectly turns 91 percent survey coverage into a nineteen-percent uncertainty allowance associated with tourists or Zone C.

Preserves Mill Junction, 1,180 veh/h, contraflow, inbound access, and route loss, but omits the forty-five-minute setup, North Bridge 54 C bus restriction, South Pass visibility trigger, County 12 protection, and observation-bound switch rules.

Accurately adds buses, qualified drivers, lift capacity, school-bus timing, ambulance exclusion, duty ceiling, and person-level matching, but does not provide cycle-time arithmetic, bridge-feasible assignments, or a concrete relief-capacity plan.

Adds medical counts, destination capacities, smoke thresholds, filter status, power coupling, and relocation concepts, but omits the 5,900 smoke-safe staffed total, accessible-cot inventory, exact shelter assignments, and complete handoff and relocation execution.

Includes Hmong, door-knock sequencing, redundant warnings, receipt evidence, and radio interoperability, but omits the ninety-minute door-knock lead, measured channel reach and outage, ASL/other-language coverage, and a fully bound common revision/effective time.

Uses the observed nineteen-hour resupply delay and recognizes staging and coupled generator/fleet effects, but never commits to twenty-four-hour local staging or an equivalent diversified supplier/County 12 route with consumption and replenishment triggers.

The ledger distinguishes service animals from pets and livestock and avoids double-counting, but the package lacks animal demand, overflow capacity, trailer cycles, route conflicts, parallel timing, and a last-safe stop rule.

Provides private/public separation, restricted medical data, verified self-evacuation, retention, and deletion concepts, but lacks minimum fields, role-level access, exact 7/30-day rules, reconciliation procedure, and deletion proof.

Provides a 48-hour sequence, some owners, contingencies, and cost authority, but it is not an executable resource-bound plan, schedules unsupported Zone C movement, and lacks complete effect/check/repair/recheck and cost-envelope bindings.

Preserves all six independent-review blockers and correctly refuses readiness, but does not carry every material exercise defect, mutated after its only actor-visible check, and ended with one final candidate effect not delivered to another actor call.

The decision treats a zone revision as a permitted count rather than binding all channels and actions to one exact revision.

The ledger declares the domain missing and the decision provides no staffed fleet assignment, cycle-time arithmetic, bridge-feasible bus routing, or legal relief capacity.

Contains a coarse 48-hour sequence and generic owners/check/repair language, but lacks exact resource and cost authority, joined assignments, effect-aware current verification, and operationally justified contingencies.

comparative_disposition.configuration_level_interaction: A1 produced materially broader and more operationally detailed exact work than D0 at nearly equal cost, but neither configuration achieved useful completion. A1's advantage is a local artifact-quality signal, not readiness or architecture promotion.
comparative_disposition.claim_limit: This is one fresh task, one seed, and a compound whole-system comparison. It does not isolate artifact coupling or prove transfer.
